title: fix: Save volume state when mount is absent
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->
```bash
root@mynuc:/tmp# podman volume create --opt type=none --opt o=bind --opt device=/tmp/data1 data1
data1

root@mynuc:/tmp# podman inspect data1
[
     {
          "Name": "data1",
          "Driver": "local",
          "Mountpoint": "/var/lib/containers/storage/volumes/data1/_data",
          "CreatedAt": "2026-10-05T23:03:20.934462499+08:00",
          "Labels": {},
          "Scope": "local",
          "Options": {
               "device": "/tmp/data1",
               "o": "bind",
               "type": "none"
          },
          "MountCount": 0,
          "NeedsCopyUp": true,
          "NeedsChown": true,
          "LockNumber": 4
     }
]

root@mynuc:/tmp# podman  volume mount data1
/var/lib/containers/storage/volumes/data1/_data

root@mynuc:/tmp# umount /var/lib/containers/storage/volumes/data1/_data/
root@mynuc:/tmp# podman inspect data1
[
     {
          "Name": "data1",
          "Driver": "local",
          "Mountpoint": "/var/lib/containers/storage/volumes/data1/_data",
          "CreatedAt": "2026-10-05T23:03:20.934462499+08:00",
          "Labels": {},
          "Scope": "local",
          "Options": {
               "device": "/tmp/data1",
               "o": "bind",
               "type": "none"
          },
          "MountCount": 1,
          "NeedsCopyUp": true,
          "NeedsChown": true,
          "LockNumber": 4
     }
]

root@mynuc:/tmp# podman  volume unmount data1
data1
```
```
root@mynuc:/tmp# podman inspect data1
[
     {
          "Name": "data1",
          "Driver": "local",
          "Mountpoint": "/var/lib/containers/storage/volumes/data1/_data",
          "CreatedAt": "2026-10-05T23:03:20.934462499+08:00",
          "Labels": {},
          "Scope": "local",
          "Options": {
               "device": "/tmp/data1",
               "o": "bind",
               "type": "none"
          },
          "MountCount": 0,  # this is right, old version with incorrect 1 even running unmount many times.
          "NeedsCopyUp": true,
          "NeedsChown": true,
          "LockNumber": 4
     }
]
```
